simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תְּדִירָא (H8411) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תְּדִירָא (tᵉdîyrâʼ) means permanence , i.e. (adverb) constantly First listed occurrence: Dan 6 17.

definitions.full: H8411. tedira תְּדִירָא noun feminine continuance ( ᵑ7 id. ; see Biblical Hebrew דּוּר ); — absolute in phrase ׳בִּת continually Dan 6:17 ; 6:21 .
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) from 1753 in the original sense of enduring;
